WITH RECURSIVE
relevant_lines AS (
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        o.order_date,
        l.sku_id AS root_sku_id,
        CAST(ol.qty AS DOUBLE) AS sold_qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND s.store_name = 'Amazon-CA-14'
),
sku_explosion AS (
    SELECT
        rl.order_id,
        rl.line_no,
        rl.order_date,
        rl.root_sku_id AS sku_id,
        rl.sold_qty AS sku_qty
    FROM relevant_lines rl

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        se.order_id,
        se.line_no,
        se.order_date,
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        se.sku_qty * CAST(bi.qty AS DOUBLE) AS sku_qty
    FROM sku_explosion se
    JOIN sales_sku parent_sku
      ON parent_sku.sku_id = se.sku_id
     AND parent_sku.is_bundle = TRUE
    JOIN bundle_item bi
      ON bi.bundle_sku_id = se.sku_id
),
model_components AS (
    SELECT
        se.order_id,
        se.line_no,
        se.order_date,
        sm.model_id,
        se.sku_qty * CAST(sm.qty AS DOUBLE) AS model_qty
    FROM sku_explosion se
    JOIN sales_sku sku
      ON sku.sku_id = se.sku_id
     AND sku.is_bundle = FALSE
    JOIN sku_model sm
      ON sm.sku_id = se.sku_id
),
model_paths AS (
    SELECT
        mc.order_id,
        mc.line_no,
        mc.order_date,
        mb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        mc.model_qty * CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) AS component_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN model_bom mb
      ON mb.model_id = mc.model_id
     AND mb.valid_from <= mc.order_date
     AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mc.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
),
component_explosion AS (
    SELECT
        mp.order_id,
        mp.line_no,
        mp.order_date,
        mp.component_id,
        mp.component_qty,
        0 AS depth
    FROM model_paths mp

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ce.order_id,
        ce.line_no,
        ce.order_date,
        cb.child_component_id,
        ce.component_qty * CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE),
        ce.depth + 1
    FROM component_explosion ce
    JOIN component c
      ON c.component_id = ce.component_id
     AND c.is_assembly = TRUE
    JOIN component_bom cb
      ON cb.parent_component_id = ce.component_id
     AND cb.valid_from <= ce.order_date
     AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR ce.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ce.component_qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM component_explosion ce
JOIN component c
  ON c.component_id = ce.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-998-OAK-02932'
  AND c.is_assembly = FALSE;

WITH RECURSIVE sold AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_date,
        s.sku_code,
        ol.qty::DOUBLE AS qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'DE'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
bom AS (
    SELECT
        sku_code AS node_code,
        'sku' AS node_kind,
        order_date,
        qty
    FROM sold

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        c.child_code AS node_code,
        c.child_kind AS node_kind,
        b.order_date,
        b.qty * c.qty AS qty
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = b.node_kind
     AND c.parent_code = b.node_code
     AND c.valid_from <= b.order_date
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR b.order_date <= c.valid_to)
    WHERE b.node_kind = 'sku'
)
SELECT node_code AS model_code
FROM bom
WHERE node_kind = 'model'
GROUP BY node_code
ORDER BY SUM(qty) DESC, node_code
LIMIT 3;

    SELECT
        b.order_id,
        b.line_no,
        b.order_date,
        b.sku_id,

    FROM base b

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        st.order_id,
        st.line_no,
        st.order_date,
        bi.item_sku_id,

comp_tree AS (
